_grammar: rules/class_abilities.py, module docstring. The engine reads these fields and never these names.
_energy_note: Positive or negative energy follows alignment in the book, and the app has no alignment yet. Owner ruling 2026-10-05: until it does, the cleric chooses at each use: heal the living or harm undead (positive), harm the living or heal undead (negative). When alignment tracking is added, this is where the choice is narrowed. The older `class_choices` "channel energy": "negative" swap still applies to the first two modes.

abilities.name: Channel Energy
abilities.source: CRB p.40 Channel Energy: 3 + Cha a day; 1d6 + 1d6 per two levels beyond 1st; 30-ft radius on the cleric; standard action; positive heals the living or harms undead (Will DC 10 + 1/2 level + Cha for half); the cleric may include herself.
abilities.text: A 30-ft burst of positive energy (heal the living or harm undead) or negative energy (harm the living or heal undead), chosen at each use. Alignment isn't tracked yet, so any cleric may channel either for now.
abilities._bonus_from_note: The harm mode reads `channel.harm-undead.damage` and `.dc` through the funnel: Sun's Blessing puts the cleric's level on the first and the Glory domain +2 on the second (content/domains/powers.json, each a passive modifier of its power). Negative energy reads `channel.negative.heals` off whoever it reaches: Death's Embrace grants that tag, and the energy heals them instead.
not_yet: With no map, everyone in the scene is in the burst.
Excluding chosen creatures (Selective Channeling): the burst takes everyone it reaches, as the book does.
